title: GameLevelPreview
responsibility: Render the generated level geometry for human review before gameplay.

inputs.name: GameLevelPreview.layout
inputs.description: The complete LevelLayout object passed unchanged as the preview view's world. The run begins at spawn.x and spawn.z; this component does not validate or modify the remaining geometry.

inputs.name: GameLevelPreview.dimension
inputs.description: Selects the 2D renderer for 2d or the 3D renderer for 3d. Changing it remounts the keyed canvas so its renderer is recreated.

inputs.name: GameLevelPreview.label
inputs.description: Sets the preview view title and canvas aria-label. It must be a string, but the component applies no validation or normalization.

outputs.name: GameLevelPreview
outputs.description: A wrapper containing a 1280-by-704 canvas; CSS scales its displayed width to the container and keeps its height automatic. The canvas uses the selected renderer and exposes the supplied label as its accessible name.
